rows.grounds: points to the nature to be known
object of knowing; compound of hidden and true nature
states the emergence of the result

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
That hidden true nature can be directly known.
Knowing that nature produces a resulting state.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
